description: Build templates 1-10: Product showcase, fashion, tech categories. Each template must have a DISTINCT layout appropriate to its archetype.
steps: Create templates/premium-performance-showcase/ - Hero product with performance stats/proof overlay layout
Create templates/modern-fashion-promotion/ - Editorial cutout fashion ad with asymmetric model placement
Create templates/summer-fashion-promotion/ - Seasonal campaign with warm tones and diagonal split layout
Create templates/minimal-editorial-fashion/ - Magazine-style clean whitespace with centered cutout
Create templates/new-fashion-launch/ - Collection launch with multi-image grid layout
Create templates/shoes-collection/ - Footwear hero with angled product and bold typography
Create templates/headphone/ - Floating tech product with radial background and specs
Create templates/speaker/ - Gadget feature ad with side-by-side product and features list
Create templates/phone/ - Smartphone launch with gradient backdrop and feature highlights
Create templates/glasses-protection/ - Product benefit ad with split layout showing protection features

Each template MUST include: manifest.json (full HyperFrame schema), layout-1x1.html (1080x1080, no JS, semantic CSS vars only), assets/ directory, thumb.png (1x1 pixel PNG placeholder), BUILD-NOTES.md
Update STATUS.json after each template is created
All layouts must be visually distinct - different grid structures, typography hierarchies, and compositional approaches
acceptance_criteria: 10 template directories exist under templates/ with all required files
No JavaScript or script tags in any HTML file
All colors use only semantic CSS variables (--surface, --surfaceAlt, --textPrimary, --textSecondary, --accent, --onAccent, --accentAlt, --textOverImage, --scrim-strong, --scrim-weak)
All fonts use only --font-display and --font-body variables
Every text element has data-role and data-importance attributes
Every image/media element has data-slot attribute

Each manifest.json has all required fields: schemaVersion, templateId, templateVersion, category, formats, when_to_use, mood, best_for, not_for, tokens, textSlots, mediaSlots, logoPolicy, layoutRules, layoutSafeZone, anchors, defaults, editable, fixtures, description
verification: ls templates/ | wc -l should show at least 10 directories
grep -rL 'data-slot' templates/*/layout-1x1.html should return nothing (all have data-slot)
